desc: Derive the binomial expansion for \(\sum_{j<r}(P_r-P_j)^K\), including alternating signs and binomial coefficients.
Design the online update order so each prefix sum only pairs with strictly earlier prefixes, including \(P_0=0\).
Implement the \(O(NK)\) Python algorithm with modular arithmetic.
Verify edge cases such as \(N=1\), zero elements, \(K=1\), and the initial prefix \(P_0=0\).
